versions.changelog:
Initial release of neckr0ik-security-suite – a complete security toolkit for OpenClaw skills.

- Scans for 20+ vulnerability types, including hardcoded secrets and injection risks.
- Auto-fixes common security issues and generates .env.example templates.
- Produces compliance reports for SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and custom frameworks.
- CLI supports scan, fix, report, and certify commands for streamlined workflow integration.
- Includes integration examples for CI/CD pipelines and pre-commit hooks.
- Suite bundle offers all tools (scanner, fixer, compliance) at a discounted price.
